metadata.title: Conformal geodesics and gauged Killing-Yano forms in dimension four
metadata.abstract: We study the relation between conformal geodesics and conformal Killing-Yano (CKY) 2-forms on anti-self-dual conformal manifolds of dimension 4. In the flat case, twistor quadrics determine self-dual CKY forms whose zero loci contain conformal geodesics. To extend this construction to curved manifolds, we consider self-dual 2-forms with values in a line bundle and satisfying the gauged CKY equation, coupled to connections with anti-self-dual curvature. In this way we provide a local ambient characterization of non-null conformal geodesics as zero curves of gauged CKY forms, with the curvature vanishing along these curves.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 研究四维反自对偶共形流形上共形测地线与共形 Killing–Yano 二形式的关系。平坦情形由扭量二次曲面产生自对偶 CKY 形式，其零集包含共形测地线；曲率情形则引入取值于线丛、耦合反自对偶曲率联络的规范 CKY 形式，给出非零型共形测地线作为零曲线的局部环境刻画，相关联络曲率沿该曲线消失。
techniques: 四维反自对偶共形几何
线丛值自对偶二形式与规范 CKY 方程
analysis.breakthrough: 把平坦扭量构造推广到曲率背景，以附加联络恢复共形测地线的零集描述。
analysis.limitations: 结论为四维反自对偶背景下的局部刻画，限非零型曲线；不能由摘要推广为全局存在、零型情形或任意维数定理。曲率沿曲线消失不等于整个邻域平坦。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者在 AI disclosure 明确说明 ChatGPT 用于扭量方法的文献搜索、Theorem 4.2 证明中的张量计算和语言核查。语言 verification 是文字用途，不据此标数学验证；未将核心思想归给模型。
